title: Social Weaver
tagline: An application that integrates social networking features with web3 technologies. Here's a brief description along with its potential
description: Social Weaver is a cutting-edge platform that merges the social connectivity of traditional social media with the decentralized, secure, and transparent nature of web3 technologies. It's designed to enhance online social interactions while empowering users with control over their data and digital identities. By leveraging blockchain technology, Social Weaver offers a unique space for users to interact, collaborate, and share content in a more secure and user-centric environment.
how_its_made: This project uses Social Connect from Celo to to map social identifiers such as twitter handles to wallet addresses. The app issues a social handle against a connected wallet addresss from the end user. the end user attests this link via oauth2 with twitter. For front end the app connects to wallets with rainbow kit.
